name: open-rule-config-engine

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rule-engine/core && npm run build -w @rule-engine/server && npm run build -w @rule-engine/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rule-engine/server" "npm run dev -w @rule-engine/client"
scripts.test:addenda: for f in addenda-tests/*.check.ts; do npx tsx "$f" | tail -1 || exit 1; done

description: Schema-driven rule and computation engine for structured documents, with a starter rule set for Indian ITR forms (AY 2024-25).
